# dsh-llm-llamacpp

A Cordis plugin for **DeepSeek Harness** that adds one or more **llama.cpp**
servers as model provid

ers and shows this session's live prompt and decode
progress in the composer dock.

> Private package: not published to npm. Tested with DSH `0.2.x` and a current
> `llama-server` buil

Private package: not published to npm. Tested with DSH `0.2.x` and a current
> `llama-server` build.
## Features

- **Declared routes, no interception.** Every key in `servers` becomes a
provider route with its own

`baseURL`, optional `alias`, and optional
credential reference. Nothing is auto-discovered or rewri

a green/red reachability dot. Removing a route is a hand edit
of the `servers` map.
- **Live discov

ery.** Models come from `/v1/models`; loaded context, output cap,
and modalities come from `/props`;

reasoning levels come from the server's
own `/apply-template` list.
- **Dock pill and dialog.** Pro

mpt progress with ETA, current prompt/decode
tok/s, per-slot context and KV use, cache hit rate, and

the raw server
metrics.
- **Warm caches under concurrency.** Sessions are pinned to a stable llama.

cpp
slot, and idle slots are reused without evicting active conversations.
- **Streaming parity.** R

etryable failure codes, assistant reasoning replay,
image handling, parallel tool calls, and disjoin

t usage accounting match the
stock pi-ai route.
- **Headless-friendly.** Routes, discovery, and stre

aming work without a web
server; the pill and dialog simply do not mount.
## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness `0.2.x`.
- `llama-server` with the OpenAI-compatible API. `/props` supplies model

and
context facts, `/apply-template` supplies reasoning levels, and `/metrics` and
`/slots` supply
the live server readings.
## Launching llama.cpp
Start `llama-server` with the flags that expose the readings this plugin shows:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

- `--metrics` enables `/metrics`: throughput, prompt-cache hit rate, speculative
decoding, and the s

erver counters in **All metrics**. It is optional — the pill
and **Server slots** still work without

it — but without it the All metrics
section only says that metrics are disabled.
- `--slots` enable

s `/slots`, which feeds **Server slots** and the session-context
line. Current builds enable it by d

efault; do not pass `--no-slots` unless you
accept losing those readings. If `--metrics` is also off

, the dialog then has
no server readings at all: only the pill's own SSE progress remains.
- `--jinj

a` uses the model's Jinja chat template, which reasoning and tool calls
depend on. Current builds en

able it by default; add it explicitly if your build
disables Jinja or you pass `--no-jinja`.
- `--ap

i-key` is optional. If you use it, store the same key in the DSH provider
card.
- `-np` above 1 lets

concurrent sessions keep separate slots, and `-c` sets the
context window. The plugin reads both fr

om `/props`; neither is configured in
DSH.

`--props` is not required: the plugin only reads `/props` with GET, and that flag
only enables `POST

is not required: the plugin only reads `/props` with GET, and that flag
only enables `POST /props`.
## Install

Install the bundle directly from GitHub. Open **Settings → Plugins** and install
from the GitHub spe

c below, or call `plugin_manager` with `action:
install_bundle` and:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

The HTTPS form works too: `https://github.com/slaren/dsh-llm-llamacpp`. The
manager installs the pac

kage and its dependencies, selects the bundle, and
applies the bundled `cordis.patch.yml`. Restart t

he host if DSH reports that a
restart is required.
### Command line
The same install from a shell, using `npx`:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

`web` is the profile to install into; substitute another profile name when
needed. If `dsh` is alrea

dy on your `PATH`, use `dsh plugin ...` instead of
`npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin ...`.

For local development, clone the repository and install the checkout by path
instead:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Then pass the absolute path (for example `link:/path/to/dsh-llm-llamacpp`) to
`install_bundle`. A ho

st-side change needs a plugin reload; client changes
appear after a page refresh.
## Configure

1. Open **Settings → Models → Add model provider** and choose **llama.cpp (new
server)**.
2. Enter t

he full API base URL, for example `http://127.0.0.1:9931/v1`.
A bare `host:port` is rejected.
3. Opt

ionally set an alias and an API key (stored as a DSH credential
reference) for servers started with

`--api-key`. No secret is stored in the
plugin config.
Or declare routes directly in the profile patch:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Model ids, context window, output cap, and reasoning levels are read from the
server, never configur

s, context window, output cap, and reasoning levels are read from the
server, never configured here.
## Usage

While a request is streaming, the pill shows progress such as
`prompt 250/1K (25%) · ETA 5s · 100 to

k/s`, then
`decode · 226 tok · 44 tok/s`. Click it for the Live progress, Server slots, and
All metr

ics sections; collapsed sections keep their headline and persist the
preference in `localStorage`.
## Development
[代码示例省略，未执行]

`test/template-test.mjs` is an optional live matrix that starts `llama-server`
with different chat t

emplates. See `AGENTS.md` for architecture and
invariants, `LLAMA_CPP_INTEGRATION.md` for upstream
p
roposals, and `CREDITS.md` for the llama.brand attribution.
## Notes

- The plugin does not start or manage `llama-server`.
- Telemetry endpoints are optional; the dialog

degrades when they are absent.
- Not affiliated with or endorsed by ggml-org.
## License

The llama.brand mark in `icon.svg` and in the client's pill and dialog title is
third-party artwork.

It is not relicensed by MIT; see CREDITS.md
for its license and the brand-usage grant.
